release_archive_verification.found: 2026-10-11, first autonomous maintenance round, by running the documented command against the delivered ZIP itself
release_archive_verification.defect: verify() read ZIP entry names straight from zipfile, which decodes a name as cp437 unless the entry sets the UTF-8 flag (bit 0x800). Python's zipfile sets that flag, so this project's own archives were always fine; the delivered ZIP was written by another tool that omits it, so 源码导航.md arrived as µ║Éτáüσ»╝Φê¬.md and the verifier reported that single file as both absent from the archive and unexpected in it.
release_archive_verification.impact: Two problems and a non-zero exit on a completely intact archive. A reviewer following the documented verification command was told the release had failed, which costs trust in a good artifact and invites repairing something that was never broken.
release_archive_verification.reproduction: python tools/build_release_manifest.py --root <baseline manifest> --verify 偷闲天大版-2.0-品位版.zip -> FAIL, 2 problems, exit 1
release_archive_verification.fix: tools/build_release_manifest.py gains archive_entry_name(), which re-decodes the name as UTF-8 when the flag is absent and keeps what zipfile returned when that is not valid UTF-8, so an archive whose names really are cp437 is left alone.
release_archive_verification.verified: The same command now reports OK: 752 files verified, exit 0.
release_archive_verification.red_first: With the one-line fix reverted, exactly one of the six cases fails and the real ZIP reproduces the identical two problems; with it, all six pass.
release_archive_verification.not_fixed_earlier: A damaged entry used to surface as an uncaught BadZipFile rather than a printed FAIL. The archive was rejected either way -- non-zero exit, and no .sha256 sidecar is written -- so this was cosmetic; it was fixed in round 2 (T15): verify() now wraps the archive open and entry read in try/except BadZipFile and prints a one-line FAIL with exit 1, pinned by three regression tests including a file that is not an archive at all.

date_parsing_regression.defect: The numeric-year date pattern (2026.11.30 / 2026-11-30 / 2026/11/30) carried no trailing boundary. The day alternation reads [0-2]?\d before 3[01], so a bare 3 won over 30 and 31: 2026.11.30 parsed as 2026-11-03, a valid date at date precision, silently 27 days early.
date_parsing_regression.reached_shipped_data: Yes. In data/campus.sqlite3 a notice reading 毕业时间：2026.09.01-2027.08.31 had 2027-08-31 stored as 2027-08-03.
date_parsing_regression.fix: server/campus/date_patterns.py adds the (?!\d) boundary to the numeric-year pattern, matching the boundary the yearless pattern always carried.
date_parsing_regression.second_defect: 24:00, how Chinese notices name the end of a day, was refused as an impossible clock and the date was dropped with it, so 11月30日24:00 reached the reader as 截止时间待确认. server/campus/content.py::_deadline_row now reads 24:00 as the next day at 00:00; every other out-of-range clock (24:30, 25:00) is still refused rather than guessed.
date_parsing_regression.red_first: 8 of the 10 new cases failed before the fix; all 10 pass after.
date_parsing_regression.regression_sweep: 17 previously-correct forms (11月30日前, 11.30, 2026年11月30日, 中午12点, the cross-year range 2026年12月25日至1月5日 and others) are unchanged.
date_parsing_regression.known_residual: The already-stored 2027-08-03 in the shipped public sample is left as delivered. Re-extracting it would rewrite reviewed historical records, which is a human-approval operation and was not performed.
date_parsing_regression.occurrences_in_shipped_sample: 24:00 appears 0 times in the shipped sample, so that half of the fix protects future notices rather than repairing stored data; the truncation half did hit stored data.

rule.withdraw: every stated deadline is in the past

round_15_daily_use.mechanism: The product's own withdrawn publication state: writes publication_audits with actor and reason, emits public_event.changed, and removes the notice from feed, public list, detail, search and answers. round_16_content_integrity.purpose: Answering 'can it be used' by measuring, not by summarising: a real daily collection was run and the review queue inspected. Two faults were found that no earlier round had surfaced, and both were silently costing real content.

defect_1_a_real_notice_was_silently_drop.symptom: A live recruitment notice (【北洋园校区】辽宁省水资源管理和生态环保产业集团2026, deadline 2026-11-13) was extracted as change_kind=cancel. A cancellation candidate without a linkable original can never be published, so a real notice with a future deadline disappeared without a trace.
defect_1_a_real_notice_was_silently_drop.cause: The standard reservation-of-rights clause in the posting — '集团有权根据岗位需求变化及报名情况等因素，调整、取消或终止个别岗位的招聘工作' — was read as a cancellation. cancellation_value() already excluded conditionals, negations, capability modal and UI actions, but a disclaimer whose right sits in the preceding clause slipped through.
defect_1_a_real_notice_was_silently_drop.fix: Two new exclusions, both scoped to the sentence: a sentence that reserves a right (有权 / 保留…权利 / 最终解释权) is skipped as a whole, and a coordinated list of the organiser's options (调整、取消或终止) is recognised as a capability, not an act.
defect_1_a_real_notice_was_silently_drop.verified: After re-extraction the notice is published and appears in the live list (actionable notices went 8 -> 9); cancellation-classified candidates went 2 -> 1, and the one that remains is the genuine '取消2022年12月份针对社会面的雅思考试'.

defect_2_the_review_policy_could_not_tel.symptom: Of 79 waiting candidates the policy accepted 78, but only one had a deadline still ahead. Publishing the rest would have put a 2021 exam schedule, the column fragment '【考试安排】2021' and a news piece into a list meant to answer 'what do I do today', and the next sweep would have taken most of them straight back down.
defect_2_the_review_policy_could_not_tel.fix: classify() now answers three questions instead of one and returns three verdicts: reject (error page, column name/fragment, form or attachment title, news piece, unlinkable cancellation, or every deadline already past), accept only when a deadline still lies ahead, and review — left pending for a human — for everything else. Undated reference material and stale documents look identical to a regex, so the machine no longer decides what a student sees; it publishes only what it can prove is actionable today.

round_16_content_integrity.invariant_now_holds: Publishing only notices with a future deadline means the expiry sweep finds nothing to do: running prune --apply right after review reported '没有已过期的事项，无需下架'. The gate and the sweep now agree, so a daily run stops churning.
round_16_content_integrity.reporting_fix: reextract reported 8 'failures' that were duplicate rows for documents whose current-rules candidate already existed — extraction resolves by (snapshot, rules), so a stale duplicate has nothing to update. They now report as superseded, with the content confirmed covered, instead of making a healthy 249-candidate run look broken.
